task_summary: Implement run-length encoding in solution.py, add unittest regression coverage in test_solution.py, and document design decisions plus the verification command in HANDOFF.md.
constraints: Work only in the supplied task workspace; do not access parent repositories or external services.
Use Python 3.11+ and the standard library.
Encode adjacent equal strings as (value, count) pairs; nonadjacent equal values form separate runs; empty input returns [].
Maintain type hints and do not mutate input collections.
Add at least 3 passing unittest test methods exercising the public API.
Include design decisions and the verification command in HANDOFF.md.
